long_description:
Dance. Celebrate. Empower. 

This Navratri, Dance for a Cause! 💃🕺✨

Join Sewa International USA - Central Jersey Chapter for an exciting evening of Garba, music, culture, and community celebration! 

Garba Night 2026 is a festive fundraiser where families and friends come together to celebrate Navratri and make a positive impact through service.

All funds raised from this event will directly support the SHE Project by Sewa International, which provides sanitation facilities, menstrual hygiene awareness, education, and skill development workshops for girls from vulnerable communities in India to foster self-reliance and dignity. 

Ticket Pricing

🎟️ Early Bird Pricing: $20 (Available through Sept 15th)

🎟️ Regular Pricing: $25 (Starting Sept 16th)

🚪 At the Door: $40 (Based on availability, per person)

💖 Special Giving & Sponsorship OpportunitiesMake a meaningful difference in a girl's life and receive complimentary event tickets as our appreciation:

Sponsor Empowerment ($360): Helps support education and dignity. Includes 2 complimentary tickets.

Support Her Future ($180): Helps bring hygiene and education. Includes 1 complimentary ticket.

Sewa CNJ Phone: 702-000-7393

Sponsorship & Booth Inquiries: +1 (848) 359-4662 / +1 (201) 772-6588

Let’s dance together and create a better tomorrow for her. 

Dance with joy. Serve with compassion. Empower her tomorrow. 🙏
